newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Angry Zimbabwe war veterans deploy bare buttocks.
newsitem.headline: Angry Zimbabwe war veterans deploy bare buttocks.

text.p: A number of angry male war veterans bared their scarred buttocks to a female Zimbabwean government minister on Thursday in the latest stage of a campaign to win back suspended war victims' compensation.

Witnesses said Florence Chitauro, the public service, labour and social welfare minister, braved the sight and continued to explain to about 200 war of independence fighters present why President Robert Mugabe's government had suspended the payments.

The payments were stopped four months ago to facilitate investigations into alleged fraud, including charges that some cabinet ministers had raided the war victims compensation fund in the past year by claiming to have suffered mental and physical disability of up to 90 percent as a result of the 1970s war.
The veterans have been fighting the suspension since then.
